en.text:
Enemies that are afflicted by this weapon's Potent Corruption create a 'Soulfire Crystal' upon death.

Soulfire Crystals have 400 HP and linger in the world for 15 seconds upon creation. Upon destruction, the crystals explode for <pve 1,065 /> <pvp [?] /> damage in an 8 meter radius, experiencing up to 25% damage falloff at the edge of the blast radius.
